description: This class provides configuration for JWT handling in a Spring Boot application, including token creation, retrieval, and refresh cookie generation.

classes.name: JwtConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration properties for JWT, including secret key, token prefixes, expiration settings, and methods for token creation and refresh cookie.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Returns the value of the Authorization header name used in HTTP requests.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for the given authentication result, using the appropriate expiration period based on whether it's a refresh token.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates and signs a JWT token with subject, authorities claim, issued at, and expiration date.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenCookie
methods.description: Returns an HTTP-only, secure cookie containing the refresh token with proper expiration settings.
